how_measured.router_exact_plan_rate: share of router cases whose full ordered plan equals the expected
how_measured.router_easy_exact_rate: same, over cases that contain a rule keyword (regression guard)
how_measured.router_hard_exact_rate: same, over realistic ambiguous cases; expected to be well below 1.0
how_measured.router_first_role_rate: share of router cases whose first dispatched role matches
how_measured.governance_verdict_rate: share of governance cases with the expected APPROVE/REVISE verdict
how_measured.governance_issue_recall: share of governance cases where every expected issue was reported
how_measured.dryrun_specialists_governance_clean: share of specialists whose dry-run output passes
how_measured.personas_written: specialist roles with a persona file
how_measured.personas_well_formed: personas that carry the required sections and reach the prompt
how_measured.persona_coverage: specialist personas divided by the number of specialist roles
how_measured.supervisor_personas_written: personas belonging to supervisors (the Engagement Lead)
how_measured.specialists_receiving_house_brief: specialists whose prompt carries the shared house brief
how_measured.specialists_receiving_engagement_context: specialists whose prompt actually carries the engagement context it was given
how_measured.context_fence_survival_rate: share of context cases where the assembled block carries exactly one fence pair and loses none of the source text — a client document containing the marker must not be able to close the fence early
how_measured.transformation_route_coverage: share of cases tagged category=transformation whose full ordered plan equals the expected one; per-case, not 'contains an advisor'
how_measured.transformation_route_coverage_derived: same, over the extraction subset the routing vocabulary was written from. Expected to be high by construction and therefore NOT evidence the router generalises
how_measured.transformation_route_coverage_holdout: same, over the holdout subset that was not read while deriving vocabulary. This is the only gated rate: below 0.80 the run fails

gated: per-case pass->fail transitions, transformation_route_coverage_holdout >= 0.80, plus router_cases, router_easy_cases, governance_cases, dryrun_specialists, personas_written, personas_well_formed, specialist_personas_written, specialists_receiving_house_brief, specialists_receiving_engagement_context, context_cases, transformation_cases, transformation_holdout_cases
